question: According to Hebrews 11:39-40, why did these people of faith not receive what had been promised in their lifetime?
options: Because God had planned something better, so that only together with us would they be made perfect
Because they disobeyed God at the end
explanation: Hebrews 11:39-40 says they were all commended for their faith, yet none received what had been promised, since God had planned something better for us so that only together with us would they be made perfect.
